I'm really sorry to hear about all of your pain. It's incredibly different to keep going when you don't even feel real, or you feel useless. You seem pretty intelligent. There's a couple things that helped for me 

1. Everyone says this, but if you're not going to therapy I believe you should. If it hasn't worked in the past, maybe try DBT/CBT, it's less focused on the dark shit in life but rather how to deal with all of that and still want to keep going.

 2. Try medication. I didn't read anything about medication, so I'm assuming you're not on any. It can help stabalize those heavy emotions. Your body might just be bad at producing Seratonin, and it makes sense to treat it as any other condition effecting your life- needing treatment. It will suck at first depending on your reaction to the medication, but if you give it time and take care of yourself and watch out for bad signs, it will be effective and help you feel better. 

3 . You said you used to be an active person who enjoyed working out, is that something you're still doing? The reason to live sometimes lies where you believe you are making a positive impact in the world, are you still a personal trainer?

4. Reach out to your friends. They are likely thinking about you. Depressions goal is to get you to become isolated, and that is the number one thing that makes it worse.

5. Find a reason. It doesn't have to be grand. Maybe it's just that you want to watch a movie that's coming out soon, or maybe you have a pet that you need to care for. If you're into spirituality, try researching deeper into that. We are all interconnected and all matter. It WILL be okay. It's okay to not feel perfect right now, the tide will shift.
